change.title: feat(web): eventsink, termul-server, ws relay, and browser-safe web bootstrap
change.description:
## Summary

Termul's ACP agent chat only runs inside the desktop app. Epic #432 (Web ACP Agent) needs the same live session stream to reach a browser via a headless server. This **draft** PR delivers all eleven Epic 1 foundation stories:

**Story 1.1 (EventSink decoupling)** — Replace direct `AppHandle::emit` calls in the ACP dispatcher with a transport-neutral `EventSink` trait and `fan_out` helper so the same `acp:*` events can feed both the desktop Tauri layer and a future WebSocket relay. Desktop behavior is unchanged (single `TauriEventSink`).

**Story 1.2 (termul-server scaffold)** — Add a feature-gated `termul-server` binary, Axum router skeleton, CLI config, Vite web build target (`dist-web/`), and CI/release wiring so the headless server can be built and shipped alongside the desktop app.

**Story 1.3 (dev static serving)** — Serve repo-root `dist-web/` via `tower-http` `ServeDir` (path from `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`, not CWD) with SPA `index.html` fallback; scaffold `rust-embed` `Assets` behind `standalone-server` with `allow_missing` so CI can compile without a prebuilt bundle. (Production `Assets::get` serving is completed in Story 1.11.)

**Story 1.4 (WS relay protocol)** — Live `WsRelaySink` with per-session monotonic `seq`, bounded event log + cursor replay, reliability-tier registry (lossy / reliable / idempotent), multiplexed `/ws` upgrade with `auth_required` placeholder + request stubs, shared TS wire types in `src/shared/types/web-protocol.types.ts`, and `--event-log-capacity` CLI tunable. Wire-level session `subscribe` / end-to-end browser delivery is deferred to Story 1.6 (renderer transport); sink API + unit tests own protocol state in 1.4.

**Story 1.5 (browser-safe web bootstrap)** — Renderer boots in a plain browser without pulling Tauri: dynamic-import `TauriApp` only when `isTauriContext()` (deduped from `@/lib/tauri-runtime`); `vite.config.web.ts` aliases `@tauri-apps/*` to `tauri-stubs` plus a fallback plugin for unlisted imports; `web-tab-session` maps tab identity via `sessionStorage` (D6 without store refactor); `acp-store` doc-comment only. Tests cover tab-session helpers and a `main.web-bundle` fingerprint (`it.skipIf` when `dist-web` is missing). Code-review follow-ups: import `.catch`, `sessionStorage` guards, OS sync sentinels, `skipIf` fingerprints.

**Story 1.6 (renderer transport adapter)** — Re-platform `src/renderer/lib/acp-api.ts` (the single ACP facade) from Tauri `invoke`/`listen` onto one multiplexed WS via `acp-transport.ts` (request/reply correlation by `id`, subscribe + cursor-replay gap-fill, reliability-tier handling). Transport selected via `tauri-runtime.ts::isTauriContext()`. `acp-store` unchanged (no store refactor). Biome `noRestrictedImports` bans `@tauri-apps/**` outside `src/renderer/lib/**`. Wire `subscribe` now on the socket.

**Story 1.7 (permission rendezvous & cross-client fan-out)** — Server-side `PermissionRendezvous` (`web/permissions.rs`, new) for the human-relayed `request_permission` cap: bounded timeout (default 60s, `--permission-timeout`, expiry -> deny via `Cancelled`), at-most-one outstanding per session (FIFO queue), first-response-wins (stale/duplicate -> `err.code`), immutable-args single-use ticket re-validated at `respond_permission` (TOCTOU -> `permission_denied`), browser disconnect -> deny-all (drains the session queue), defense-in-depth `agentId`/session-ownership checks. Never holds the `!Send` ACP `Responder` -- forwards through `AcpManager::respond_permission`. Also adds `TurnWatermark` (FR13/FR11 turn-id dedup plumbing; wire `turnId` field in 1.8) and `map_prompt_error_code` (`ACP_TURN_IN_PROGRESS` -> `RateLimited` for 1.8's `send_prompt`). Desktop path byte-for-byte unchanged (no rendezvous attached).

**Story 1.8 (browser ACP chat UI over WS)** — Wire the 10 ACP WS request handlers (`send_prompt`/`create_session`/`load_session`/`resume_session`/`close_session`/`list_sessions`/`cancel_prompt`/`set_mode`/`set_model`/`set_config_option`) to `AcpManager` in `web/ws.rs::handle_request`. Client `turnId` end-to-end: `sendPrompt`/`sendPromptBlocks` generate a `crypto.randomUUID()` turnId (`acp-transport.ts`), the server threads it through `AcpCommand::SendPrompt` -> the turn task -> `PromptCompleteEvent.turn_id` (echoed back so the renderer's `seenTurnIds` idempotent dedup fires — FR11). `TurnWatermark` (FR13) wired: `send_prompt` rejects a stale turn (`is_completed` -> `stale`) + advances on completion (`record_completed`). `map_prompt_error_code` maps `ACP_TURN_IN_PROGRESS` -> `rate_limited`. Guards: empty-`cwd` + empty-`text` rejection; recognizable-error -> `err.code` mapping (unknown agent -> `not_found`, capability-gate -> `unsupported`). Read-only MCP badge in the composer (`McpBadge.tsx`, new — AC1 "read-only badge for v1; edit via New Chat"). Streaming events flow automatically through the existing `fan_out` -> `WsRelaySink::emit` -> WS -> store pipeline (the chat UI is transport-agnostic since 1.6 + mounts in the web build). Desktop path byte-for-byte unchanged (`turn_id: None` -> `skip_serializing_if` keeps payloads byte-identical).

**Story 1.9 (agent crash handling + bounded turn timeout)** — Add the typed `AgentCrashedEvent` + `EVENT_AGENT_CRASHED` to `events.rs`; `run_agent` teardown emits `agent_crashed` BEFORE `agent_error`/`agent_disconnected` so the renderer distinguishes crash from clean disconnect -> `status: 'error'` + manual restart (no silent respawn, ADR-003). Bounded per-turn timeout (NFR7 — `TURN_TIMEOUT=600s`, configurable via `TERMUL_ACP_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECS`; on timeout `signal_cancel` + `CANCEL_GRACE` race -> typed error -> Error state). Terminal non-interactive contract (FR24) VERIFIED: `acp/terminal.rs` is already non-interactive exec+capture; `terminal/*` is OS-fulfilled (browser -> `unsupported`); desktop PTY unchanged. Review fixes: `_onAgentDisconnected` preserves `status: 'error'` (was overwriting to `closed` — the HIGH fix); `_onAgentError` (turn-scoped) sets `status: 'error'` (NFR7); `_onAgentCrashed` guards against resurrecting closed sessions.

**Story 1.10 (desktop-hosted shared-live mode)** — The desktop's status-bar control now starts/stops an in-process ACP web server (`remote/host.rs`) that shares the desktop's live `AcpManager` sessions with a browser/phone over the LAN. Extracted `serve_router` (binds + spawns the Axum serve loop, returns `(SocketAddr, JoinHandle)`, does NOT call `kill_all`) from `web::serve`; the desktop path calls `serve_router` directly with an oneshot-driven shutdown so toggling the server off never kills the desktop's live agents (the kill-all hazard). Removed the legacy PTY bridge (`remote/ws.rs`, `remote/auth.rs`, `remote/registry.rs`, `remote/server.rs`, `remote/static/**`) + the `remote_publish_projects` command/renderer API/types (the ACP web server has no `/api/projects` or `/api/spawn` routes — the phone connects to a session via the WS URL). Desktop `AcpManager` now fans ACP events out to `TauriEventSink` + `WsRelaySink` (serialize-once-fan-N; `TauriEventSink` payloads stay byte-identical). A `PermissionRendezvous` is attached to the `WsRelaySink` (built with an explicit `tauri::async_runtime` handle so the FR14 per-ticket timeout reliably arms from the agent driver thread); the Tauri + WS permission paths converge on `AcpManager`'s single-use `take_permission` gate — first response wins, and the desktop command maps a lose-race "unknown permission request" to a benign already-resolved outcome. Code review (4 parallel layers): all 4 ACs satisfied; 13 findings triaged — 10 patched, 1 dismissed (the per-session ring is load-bearing for late-join cursor replay), 2 deferred.

**Story 1.11 (static bundle embedding — rust-embed)** — Promote `rust-embed` from optional/`standalone-server`-gated to always-on so the desktop app ALSO embeds the Vite web bundle — the desktop's in-process shared-live server (Story 1.10's `remote/host.rs` → `serve_router` → `router()`) serves the SAME embedded bundle in a release install without `dist-web/` on disk. `serve_embedded` axum handler: disk `ServeDir` when `dist-web/` is on disk (dev, preserves Vite iteration), else the embedded `Assets` (release, self-contained binary); SPA `index.html` fallback for the hash-router client; Content-Type via `Metadata::mimetype` (mime-guess feature). `build.rs` emits a `web_embed_missing` cfg when `dist-web/index.html` is absent → a release-only `compile_error!` fails the build clearly ("run `bun run build:web` before building a release binary"); dev stays green via `allow_missing` + the `not(debug_assertions)` gate. CI runs `bun run build:web` before `cargo build --bin termul-server` (PR + release) + before `cargo test` (so the embed OK-path tests run). Code review (4 parallel layers): all 3 ACs + 6 invariants satisfied; 16 findings triaged — 6 patched (incl. the CRITICAL desktop-release-build break where the `release.yml` `build` matrix job didn't run `build:web` → `compile_error!` on every tagged release; immutable `Cache-Control` on `index.html` breaking upgrades; dotted client routes 404; `router()` disk-or-embed branch untested; adaptive `serve_embedded` tests + CI not exercising the OK-path), 6 deferred, 4 dismissed.

## Related Issue

Closes #434 (Story 1.1 — D2 dispatcher decoupling: AppHandle → EventSink)
Closes #435 (Story 1.2 — standalone server binary and web build scaffold)
Closes #438 (Story 1.7 — permission rendezvous & cross-client fan-out)
Closes #439 (Story 1.8 — browser ACP chat UI over WS)
Closes #440 (Story 1.9 — agent crash handling + terminal non-interactive contract)
Refs #432 (Epic — Web ACP Agent: headless server + browser client; this PR does not close the epic)

No duplicate PRs found for EventSink decoupling, termul-server scaffold, ServeDir static serving, WS relay protocol, browser-safe bootstrap, or desktop-hosted shared-live mode (searched open + closed PRs). Story 1.10 has no dedicated tracking issue (only some Epic-1 stories carried issues); it is part of Epic #432.

## Type of Change

- [ ] docs: documentation only

- [x] refactor: internal cleanup with no behavior change
- [ ] perf: performance improvement

- [ ] revert: reverts a previous change

## What Changed

**Story 1.1 — EventSink decoupling**
- Added `src-tauri/src/web/sink.rs` with `EventSink` trait, `TauriEventSink`, `WsRelaySink` stub, and serialize-once `fan_out`
- Refactored `acp/events.rs`, `acp/client.rs`, and `acp/manager.rs` to route all `acp:*` emissions through `Vec<Arc<dyn EventSink>>` instead of `AppHandle`
- Wired desktop mode in `lib.rs` with a single `TauriEventSink` (byte-identical renderer event flow)
- Hardened fan-out after code review (96ca3f2c): error handling, test coverage, documentation

**Story 1.2 — termul-server and web build scaffold**
- Added `termul-server` binary (`src/server_main.rs`, outside `src/bin/` to avoid Tauri bundler re-discovery — tauri#15325)
- Added `web/config.rs` (CLI `--host`/`--port`), `web/router.rs` (Axum skeleton), and `web/mod.rs::serve` with graceful shutdown
- Added `vite.config.web.ts`, `build:web` script, and `dist-web/` output for the future browser client
- Gated binary behind `standalone-server` Cargo feature; feature-gated `build.rs` `rerun-if-changed=../dist-web`
- CI: build + clippy termul-server on Linux/Windows; release workflow builds web client, compiles linux-x64 binary, uploads artifact, attaches to draft release
- Review fixes (6ecc833c): shutdown ordering (Axum drain then `kill_all`), signal handler error handling, CLI port-zero rejection, extended tests

**Story 1.3 — Dev static serving & rust-embed scaffold**
- Added `web/assets.rs`: `dist_web_dir()`, `static_service` / `static_service_from`, `dist_web_ready()`, and cfg-gated `#[derive(rust_embed::Embed)]` with `#[folder = "../dist-web/"]` + `#[allow_missing = true]`
- Replaced `/` 503 stub with `.fallback_service(ServeDir + ServeFile index.html)` so `/health` and `/ws` keep priority
- Startup `warn!` when `dist-web/index.html` is missing
- Fixture-based router tests (temp roots, SPA fallback, 404 when missing/nonexistent, Drop cleanup)
- Code-review follow-up: `allow_missing` unblocks CI `standalone-server-build` without `build:web`

**Story 1.4 — WS relay protocol (envelope, seq, event log, cursor, tiers)**
- Replaced `WsRelaySink` stub with live relay state: per-session `SessionState` (atomic seq + bounded ring), subscriber set, lossy drop-oldest ring, cursor replay (`ReplayResult::Ok` / `Stale`)
- Added `web/ws.rs`: `/ws` upgrade, `auth_required` first frame, `authenticate` placeholder, OS-cap `unsupported` rejection, other requests `not_implemented`
- Wired `serve(acp, ws_relay, cfg)` + `AppState { acp, relay }`; standalone registers only `WsRelaySink`
- Added `src/shared/types/web-protocol.types.ts` (+ colocated tests) mirroring Rust envelopes, tiers, error codes, OS/human caps
- Added `--event-log-capacity` CLI (default 4096)
- Code-review follow-up: lock-order hygiene, subscribe TOCTOU fix, mid-replay/send-fail cleanup, lossy flush on enqueue, `select!` aborts sibling task, AC11 tests (eviction, replay, stale, drop-oldest, reliable, cross-session isolation)
- Deferred to Story 1.6: wire-level session subscribe / browser E2E delivery / `stale` reply on the socket (AC2 has no `subscribe` request type in 1.4)

**Story 1.5 — Browser-safe bootstrap, Tauri stubs, tab session mapping**
- `main.tsx`: dynamic-import desktop shell only in Tauri context; web path avoids eager Tauri imports
- `vite.config.web.ts`: `@tauri-apps/*` → `src/renderer/lib/tauri-stubs/` aliases; plugin catches unlisted `@tauri-apps` imports
- `tauri-stubs/`: no-op or safe-failure stubs for API, plugins, and `unavailable` helper
- `web-tab-session.ts`: `sessionStorage` tab/session mapping for web (D6) without refactoring stores
- `acp-store.ts`: documentation comment for web vs desktop session identity
- Tests: `web-tab-session.test.ts`, `main.web-bundle.test.ts` (bundle fingerprint; skips when `dist-web` absent)
- Review follow-ups: failed dynamic import `.catch`, guarded `sessionStorage`, OS plugin sync sentinels, `skipIf` for missing bundle artifacts

**Story 1.10 — Desktop-hosted shared-live mode**
- `web/mod.rs`: extracted `serve_router(acp, ws_relay, cfg, shutdown)` (binds the listener synchronously, spawns the `axum::serve` loop, returns `(SocketAddr, JoinHandle)`, does NOT call `kill_all`) from `serve()`. The standalone `serve()` wraps `serve_router` + `kill_all`; the desktop path calls `serve_router` directly with an oneshot-driven shutdown — toggling the server off never touches the desktop's live agents.
- `remote/host.rs` (new): `RemoteServerState` wrapping the in-process server (mirrors the old PTY-bridge lifecycle but with `Arc<AcpManager>` + `Arc<WsRelaySink>`). `start()` builds a `ServerConfig` (`port: 0` OS-assigned), spawns `serve_router`, stores the `JoinHandle` + shutdown sender. `stop()` signals drain + awaits the handle (the standalone "drain Axum then kill" ordering holds on desktop too). `status()` treats a finished serve task as stopped (no false "running"). The lose-race arm sends shutdown before returning `Err` (no orphan second server).
- Removed the legacy PTY bridge: `remote/ws.rs`, `remote/auth.rs`, `remote/registry.rs`, `remote/server.rs`, `remote/static/**`; `remote/mod.rs` now only `pub mod host`. Removed the `remote_publish_projects` command + its `invoke_handler!` registration + the renderer `publishProjects` API/`RemoteProjectTree` types (the ACP web server has no `/api/projects` or `/api/spawn` routes — the phone connects to a session via the WS URL). `use-remote-projects.ts` reduced to status-polling (the StatusBar indicator still works).
- `lib.rs`: desktop `AcpManager::new` now fans out to `TauriEventSink` + `WsRelaySink` (serialize-once-fan-N; `TauriEventSink` payloads stay byte-identical). A `PermissionRendezvous` is attached to the `WsRelaySink`, built with `PermissionRendezvous::with_handle(..., tauri::async_runtime::handle().inner().clone())` so the FR14 per-ticket timeout reliably arms from the agent driver thread (no reliance on `Handle::try_current()` at Tauri `setup` time). The Tauri + WS permission paths converge on `AcpManager`'s single-use `take_permission` gate (first response wins); `acp_respond_permission` maps a lose-race "unknown permission request" to a benign `Ok(())`.
- `commands.rs`: `remote_server_start` drops the `pty_manager` arg, adds `acp_manager` + `ws_relay` state; rejects explicit-but-unrecognized `bindMode` instead of silently defaulting to localhost.
- `RemoteAccessPopover.tsx`: wording updated to "live agent sessions"; LAN-expose warning states auth lands in a later release (AC3).
- Code review (4 parallel layers — blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap, acceptance-auditor): all 4 ACs satisfied; 13 findings triaged — 10 patched (dropped-`JoinHandle` observability + double-start orphan, `0.0.0.0` loopback URL → `None`, Tauri permission lose-race mapping, rendezvous runtime handle, malformed bind-mode rejection, stale `remote::server` doc refs, `serve_router`-never-`kill_all` structural guard + host lifecycle tests), 1 dismissed (the per-session ring is load-bearing for late-join cursor replay), 2 deferred (`std::sync::Mutex::lock().unwrap()` convention; cross-path first-wins direct test).

**Story 1.11 — Static bundle embedding (rust-embed)**
- `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`: `rust-embed` promoted to non-optional + always-on (the `mime-guess` feature for `Metadata::mimetype`); `standalone-server` no longer gates the dep (it gates only the `[[bin]]` via `required-features`).
- `src-tauri/src/web/assets.rs`: `Assets` ungated + always-on (was `#[cfg(feature = "standalone-server")]` + dead); `serve_embedded`/`embedded_index`/`embedded_response` handlers (disk `ServeDir` when `dist_web_ready()` in dev, else the embedded `Assets` in release). SPA `index.html` fallback via `last_segment_has_extension` (only the last path segment's `.` is treated as an asset — a dotted client route like `/v1.2/home` → `index.html`, not 404). `index.html` served with `no-cache, must-revalidate` (it's the manifest referencing hashed chunks — immutable caching would 404 old chunks after an upgrade); hashed assets keep `immutable`. `web_embed_missing` release-only `compile_error!` for a missing/stale `dist-web/`.
- `src-tauri/src/web/router.rs`: `router()` picks the disk-or-embed fallback at build time (`/health` + `/ws` registered before it — Story 1.3 AC1 preserved). `router_with_static` (test seam) keeps the explicit `ServeDir`.
- `src-tauri/build.rs`: always-on `rerun-if-changed=../dist-web` (desktop too, since it embeds); emits `cargo:rustc-check-cfg=cfg(web_embed_missing)` + sets it when `dist-web/index.html` is absent.
- CI: `pr-validation.yml` `standalone-server-build` + `rust-windows-check` run `bun run build:web` before the cargo build; `rust-checks` runs `build:web` before `cargo test` (so the embed OK-path tests run); `release.yml` desktop `build` matrix job + `standalone-server` job run `build:web` before the release cargo build (the CRITICAL review fix — without it the desktop release hit the `compile_error!`).
- Code review (4 parallel layers — blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap, acceptance-auditor): all 3 ACs + 6 invariants satisfied; 16 findings triaged — 6 patched (CRITICAL desktop-release-build break; immutable `index.html` cache → upgrades; dotted-route 404; `router()` branch untested; adaptive tests + CI not exercising OK-path), 6 deferred, 4 dismissed.

**Out of scope (later stories):** auth/TLS (Epic 2). Epic 1 is complete (all 11 stories done).

+
+      void listen<T>(eventName, (event) => {
+        callback(event.payload)
+      })
+        .then((unlisten) => {
+          if (unlistenCalledEarly) {
+            unlisten()
+            return
+          }
+          resolvedUnlisten = unlisten

+      return () => {

+        } else {
+          unlistenCalledEarly = true
+        }
+      }
+    },
+    connect: async () => {
+      /* desktop uses Tauri IPC — no socket */
+    },
+    dispose: () => {
+      /* no-op */
+    }
+  }

+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// WS URL + client
+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+/** Resolve `ws(s)://{host}/ws` — same origin in the web build. */
+export function resolveWsUrl(
+  locationLike: { protocol: string; host: string } = window.location
+): string {
+  const proto = locationLike.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'
+  return `${proto}//${locationLike.host}/ws`
+}
+
+const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000
+const RECONNECT_BASE_MS = 500
+const RECONNECT_MAX_MS = 8_000
+
+type Pending = {
+  resolve: (value: unknown) => void
+  reject: (err: unknown) => void
+  timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>
+}
+
+type EventListener = (payload: unknown) => void
+
+/**
+ * Multiplexed ACP WS client.
+ *
+ * On `stale` subscribe reply: clear per-session seq/buffer + turn-id dedup and
+ * resubscribe live-only (omit `lastSeq`).
+ */
+export class WsAcpTransport implements AcpTransport {
+  private socket: WebSocket | null = null
+  private authed = false
+  private connecting: Promise<void> | null = null
+  private disposed = false
+  private reconnectAttempt = 0
+  private reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
+  private readonly pending = new Map<string, Pending>()
+  private readonly listeners = new Map<string, Set<EventListener>>()
+  /** Per-session last contiguous delivered seq. */
+  private readonly lastSeq = new Map<string, number>()
+  /** Per-session out-of-order buffer keyed by seq. */
+  private readonly hold = new Map<string, Map<number, WsEvent>>()
+  /** Sessions we should re-subscribe after reconnect. */
+  private readonly subscribed = new Set<string>()
+  /** Idempotent prompt_complete turn ids already delivered. */
+  private readonly seenTurnIds = new Set<string>()
+  private readonly wsUrl: string
+  private readonly webSocketCtor: typeof WebSocket
+
+  constructor(opts?: { url?: string; WebSocketImpl?: typeof WebSocket }) {
+    this.wsUrl =
+      opts?.url ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? resolveWsUrl() : 'ws://127.0.0.1:8080/ws')
+    this.webSocketCtor = opts?.WebSocketImpl ?? WebSocket
+  }
+
+  async connect(): Promise<void> {
+    if (this.disposed) return
+    if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN && this.authed) return
+    if (this.connecting) return this.connecting
+    this.connecting = this.openSocket()
+    try {
+      await this.connecting
+    } finally {
+      this.connecting = null
+    }
+  }
+
+  dispose(): void {
+    this.disposed = true
+    if (this.reconnectTimer) {
+      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer)
+      this.reconnectTimer = null
+    }
+    for (const [, p] of this.pending) {
+      clearTimeout(p.timer)
+      p.reject(new AcpTransportError('closed', 'transport disposed'))
+    }
+    this.pending.clear()
+    this.socket?.close()
+    this.socket = null
+  }
+
+  async subscribeSession(
+    sessionId: SessionId,
+    lastSeq?: number | null,
+    force = false
+  ): Promise<void> {
+    await this.connect()
+    // Skip no-op re-subscribe when already live-subscribed (sendPrompt path).
+    if (!force && lastSeq === undefined && this.subscribed.has(sessionId)) {
+      return
+    }
+    this.subscribed.add(sessionId)
+    const payload: { sessionId: string; lastSeq?: number } = { sessionId }
+    if (lastSeq != null) {
+      payload.lastSeq = lastSeq
+    } else if (lastSeq === undefined && this.lastSeq.has(sessionId)) {
+      payload.lastSeq = this.lastSeq.get(sessionId)
+    }
+    // lastSeq === null → omit field → server live-only (stale recovery).
+    try {
+      await this.request('subscribe', payload)
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err instanceof AcpTransportError && err.code === WS_ERROR_CODES.STALE) {
+        // Stale: clear buffers + turn-id dedup, then live-only resubscribe (no lastSeq).
+        this.hold.delete(sessionId)
+        this.lastSeq.delete(sessionId)
+        this.seenTurnIds.clear()
+        await this.request('subscribe', { sessionId })
+        return
+      }
+      throw err
+    }
+  }
+
+  onEvent<T>(eventName: string, callback: (payload: T) => void): () => void {
+    const wsType = toWsEventType(eventName)
+    let set = this.listeners.get(wsType)
+    if (!set) {
+      set = new Set()
+      this.listeners.set(wsType, set)
+    }
+    const wrapped: EventListener = (payload) => callback(payload as T)
+    set.add(wrapped)
+    // Ensure socket is up so events can arrive.
+    void this.connect().catch(console.error)
+    return () => {
+      set?.delete(wrapped)
+      if (set && set.size === 0) this.listeners.delete(wsType)
+    }
+  }
+
+  // --- Desktop-only / short-circuit methods --------------------------------
+
+  async installRegistryBinary(
+    _request: InstallAcpRegistryBinaryRequest
+  ): Promise<InstallAcpRegistryBinaryOutcome> {
+    throw new AcpTransportError('unsupported', 'Registry binary install is desktop-only')
+  }
+
+  async probeRuntime(): Promise<AcpRuntimeAvailability> {
+    return { npx: true, uvx: true }
+  }
+
+  async fetchRegistrySnapshot(_forceRefresh = false): Promise<AcpRegistrySnapshot> {

+
+  async spawnAgent(config: AgentConfig): Promise<AgentId> {

+
+  async newSession(
+    agentId: AgentId,
+    cwd: string,

+      mcpServers

+
+  async loadSession(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId, cwd: string): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('load_session', { agentId, sessionId, cwd })
+    await this.subscribeSession(sessionId)
+  }
+
+  async resumeSession(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId, cwd: string): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('resume_session', { agentId, sessionId, cwd })
+    await this.subscribeSession(sessionId)
+  }
+
+  async closeSession(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('close_session', { agentId, sessionId })
+    this.subscribed.delete(sessionId)
+    this.lastSeq.delete(sessionId)
+    this.hold.delete(sessionId)
+  }
+
+  async listSessions(
+    agentId: AgentId,
+    cwd?: string,
+    cursor?: string
+  ): Promise<ListSessionsResponse> {
+    return this.request<ListSessionsResponse>('list_sessions', { agentId, cwd, cursor })
+  }
+
+  async sendPrompt(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId, text: string): Promise<StopReason> {
+    await this.subscribeSession(sessionId) // no-op if already subscribed
+    // Story 1.8 T3.1 (FR11): generate a client turn-id so the server echoes it
+    // back on `prompt_complete` → our `seenTurnIds` dedup fires (no duplicate
+    // completion on reconnect replay). `crypto.randomUUID()` (available in
+    // browsers + Node 19+; the web build targets modern evergreen browsers).
+    const turnId = crypto.randomUUID()
+    return this.request<StopReason>('send_prompt', { agentId, sessionId, text, turnId })
+  }
+
+  async sendPromptBlocks(
+    agentId: AgentId,
+    sessionId: SessionId,
+    content: ContentBlock[]
+  ): Promise<StopReason> {
+    await this.subscribeSession(sessionId)
+    const turnId = crypto.randomUUID()
+    return this.request<StopReason>('send_prompt', { agentId, sessionId, content, turnId })
+  }
+
+  async cancelPrompt(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('cancel_prompt', { agentId, sessionId })
+  }
+
+  async setConfigOption(
+    agentId: AgentId,
+    sessionId: SessionId,
+    configId: string,
+    valueId: string
+  ): Promise<SessionConfigOption[]> {
+    return this.request<SessionConfigOption[]>('set_config_option', {
+      agentId,
+      sessionId,
+      configId,
+      valueId
+    })
+  }
+
+  async setMode(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId, modeId: string): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('set_mode', { agentId, sessionId, modeId })
+  }
+
+  async setModel(agentId: AgentId, sessionId: SessionId, modelId: string): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('set_model', { agentId, sessionId, modelId })
+  }
+
+  async respondPermission(agentId: AgentId, requestId: string, optionId?: string): Promise<void> {
+    await this.request('respond_permission', { agentId, requestId, optionId })
+  }
+
+  /** Agent method auth — distinct from relay `authenticate` token gate. */
+  async authenticate(agentId: AgentId, methodId: string): Promise<void> {
+    // Not in WS_REQUEST_TYPES as agent auth; server may still stub.
+    // Keep a clear error until 1.8 wires agent auth over WS if needed.
+    throw new AcpTransportError(
+      'not_implemented',
+      `Agent authenticate(${agentId}, ${methodId}) is not available over WS yet`
+    )
+  }
+
+  // --- Internals -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+  private async openSocket(): Promise<void> {
+    if (this.disposed) return
+    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
+      let settled = false
+      const settleOk = () => {
+        if (settled) return
+        settled = true
+        resolve()
+      }
+      const settleErr = (err: Error) => {
+        if (settled) return
+        settled = true
+        reject(err)
+      }
+
+      const ws = new this.webSocketCtor(this.wsUrl)
+      this.socket = ws
+      this.authed = false
+
+      ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
+        void this.onMessage(String(ev.data))
+          .then(() => {
+            if (this.authed) settleOk()
+          })
+          .catch((err) => {
+            try {
+              ws.close()
+            } catch {
+              /* ignore */
+            }
+            settleErr(err instanceof Error ? err : new AcpTransportError('closed', String(err)))
+          })
+      }
+
+      ws.onerror = () => {
+        this.rejectAllPending('closed', 'WebSocket error')
+        settleErr(new AcpTransportError('closed', 'WebSocket error'))
+      }
+
+      ws.onclose = () => {
+        this.socket = null
+        this.authed = false
+        this.rejectAllPending('closed', 'WebSocket closed')
+        if (!this.disposed) this.scheduleReconnect()
+        settleErr(new AcpTransportError('closed', 'WebSocket closed before auth'))
+      }
+
+      setTimeout(() => {
+        if (!this.authed) {
+          try {
+            ws.close()
+          } catch {
+            /* ignore */
+          }
+          settleErr(new AcpTransportError('closed', 'WebSocket auth handshake timeout'))
+        }
+      }, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
+    })
+  }
+
+  private rejectAllPending(code: string, message: string): void {
+    for (const [, p] of this.pending) {
+      clearTimeout(p.timer)
+      p.reject(new AcpTransportError(code, message))
+    }
+    this.pending.clear()
+  }
+
+  private scheduleReconnect(): void {
+    if (this.disposed || this.reconnectTimer) return
+    const delay = Math.min(RECONNECT_BASE_MS * 2 ** this.reconnectAttempt, RECONNECT_MAX_MS)
+    this.reconnectAttempt += 1
+    this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
+      this.reconnectTimer = null
+      void this.reconnect()
+    }, delay)
+  }
+
+  private async reconnect(): Promise<void> {
+    try {
+      await this.connect()
+      this.reconnectAttempt = 0
+      for (const sid of [...this.subscribed]) {
+        const last = this.lastSeq.get(sid)
+        // Force re-subscribe after reconnect; pass cursor when known.
+        await this.subscribeSession(sid, last ?? null, true)
+      }
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error('[acp-transport] reconnect failed', err)
+      this.scheduleReconnect()
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async onMessage(raw: string): Promise<void> {
+    let parsed: unknown
+    try {
+      parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
+    } catch {
+      return
+    }
+    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return
+    const obj = parsed as Record<string, unknown>
+
+    // Reply frame: has `ok` boolean + `id`
+    if (typeof obj.id === 'string' && typeof obj.ok === 'boolean') {
+      this.handleReply(obj as unknown as WsReply)
+      return
+    }
+
+    // Event frame: has `type` + `seq`
+    if (typeof obj.type === 'string' && typeof obj.seq === 'number') {
+      await this.handleEvent(obj as unknown as WsEvent)
+    }
+  }
+
+  private handleReply(reply: WsReply): void {
+    const pending = this.pending.get(reply.id)
+    if (!pending) return
+    clearTimeout(pending.timer)
+    this.pending.delete(reply.id)
+    if (reply.ok) {
+      pending.resolve(reply.payload)
+    } else {
+      pending.reject(new AcpTransportError(reply.err.code, reply.err.message || reply.err.code))
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async handleEvent(evt: WsEvent): Promise<void> {
+    if (evt.type === 'auth_required') {
+      // Placeholder relay token until Epic 2 — never store in localStorage/query.
+      // Send directly (socket is already open); do NOT call request()→connect()
+      // or we deadlock on the in-flight connect promise.
+      try {
+        await this.sendWhenOpen('authenticate', { token: 'dev' })
+        this.authed = true
+      } catch (err) {
+        try {
+          this.socket?.close()
+        } catch {
+          /* ignore */
+        }
+        throw err instanceof Error ? err : new AcpTransportError('closed', 'authenticate failed')
+      }
+      this.emitLocal(evt.type, evt.payload)
+      return
+    }
+
+    // Agent-level / relay events (seq 0, sid null): deliver immediately.
+    if (evt.sid == null || evt.seq === 0) {
+      this.emitLocal(evt.type, evt.payload)
+      return
+    }
+
+    const sid = evt.sid
+    const tier = wsTierOf(evt.type)
+    const last = this.lastSeq.get(sid) ?? 0
+
+    if (evt.seq <= last) {
+      // Duplicate — ignore.
+      return
+    }
+
+    // Idempotent prompt_complete: drop duplicate turn-id but still advance cursor
+    // when contiguous so the seq pipeline cannot stall.
+    if (tier === 'idempotent' && evt.type === 'prompt_complete') {
+      const turnId = extractTurnId(evt.payload)
+      if (turnId && this.seenTurnIds.has(turnId)) {
+        if (evt.seq === last + 1) {
+          this.lastSeq.set(sid, evt.seq)
+          this.flushHold(sid)
+        }
+        return
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (evt.seq === last + 1) {
+      this.deliverContiguous(sid, evt)
+      this.flushHold(sid)
+      return
+    }
+
+    // Gap: lossy may never arrive — emit without advancing lastSeq past the hole
+    // (do not jump the cursor over undelivered reliable/idempotent seqs).
+    if (tier === 'lossy') {
+      this.emitLocal(evt.type, evt.payload)
+      return
+    }
+
+    // Reliable / idempotent: hold until contiguous.
+    this.bufferHold(sid, evt)
+  }
+
+  private bufferHold(sid: string, evt: WsEvent): void {
+    let map = this.hold.get(sid)
+    if (!map) {
+      map = new Map()
+      this.hold.set(sid, map)
+    }
+    map.set(evt.seq, evt)
+  }
+
+  private deliverContiguous(sid: string, evt: WsEvent): void {
+    this.lastSeq.set(sid, evt.seq)
+    if (evt.type === 'prompt_complete') {
+      const turnId = extractTurnId(evt.payload)
+      if (turnId) this.seenTurnIds.add(turnId)
+    }
+    this.emitLocal(evt.type, evt.payload)
+  }
+
+  private flushHold(sid: string): void {
+    const map = this.hold.get(sid)
+    if (!map) return
+    for (;;) {
+      const last = this.lastSeq.get(sid) ?? 0
+      const next = map.get(last + 1)
+      if (!next) break
+      map.delete(last + 1)
+      this.deliverContiguous(sid, next)
+    }
+  }
+
+  private emitLocal(wsType: string, payload: unknown): void {
+    const set = this.listeners.get(wsType)
+    if (!set) return
+    for (const cb of set) {
+      try {
+        cb(payload)
+      } catch (err) {
+        console.error('[acp-transport] listener error', err)
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  private request<T = unknown>(type: WsRequestType, payload: unknown): Promise<T> {
+    // Ensure connected first (unless socket already open — avoids reconnect loops).
+    if (this.socket?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
+      return this.sendWhenOpen(type, payload)
+    }
+    return this.connect().then(() => this.sendWhenOpen(type, payload))
+  }
+
+  /** Send a request assuming the socket is already OPEN (used during auth handshake). */
+  private sendWhenOpen<T = unknown>(type: WsRequestType, payload: unknown): Promise<T> {
+    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
+      const id = crypto.randomUUID()
+      const frame: WsRequest = { id, type, payload }
+      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
+        this.pending.delete(id)
+        reject(new AcpTransportError('timeout', `Request ${type} timed out`))
+      }, REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
+      this.pending.set(id, {
+        resolve: (v) => resolve(v as T),
+        reject,
+        timer
+      })
+      if (!this.socket || this.socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
+        clearTimeout(timer)
+        this.pending.delete(id)
+        reject(new AcpTransportError('closed', 'WebSocket not open'))
+        return
+      }
+      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(frame))
+    })
+  }

+/**
+ * WS relay protocol frame schema (Story 1.4).
+ *
+ * Single source of truth for the wire contract between the standalone
+ * `termul-server` WS relay (`src-tauri/src/web/ws.rs`) and any browser client.
+ * Mirrors the Rust structs/enums in `web/ws.rs` one-to-one.
+ *
+ * # Wire casing (AC3 — deviation from architecture text, MUST follow)
+ *
+ * The **envelope** fields (`sid`, `seq`, `type`, `payload`) are snake_case.
+ * The **payload** is the existing camelCase-serialized ACP event struct
+ * `Value` (byte-identical to what `TauriEventSink` emits today). The relay
+ * serializes the payload ONCE via `fan_out` and forwards the `Value`
+ * verbatim — this file does NOT re-case payload fields. `acp-api.ts` becomes
+ * a no-op case boundary for payload fields; only the envelope is mapped.
+ *
+ * # Reliability tiers (AC5)
+ *
+ * `WS_RELAY_TIERS` is the single registry mapping each event `type` to its
+ * delivery tier. Mirrors the Rust `ReliabilityTier` enum + `tier_of(type_)`.
+ * Lossy events drop-oldest on a slow client; reliable events never drop
+ * (unbounded per-client queue in this story); idempotent events dedup by
+ * turn-id. Full ack/backpressure lands in Story 1.7.
+ *
+ * # OS vs human cap boundary (AC8)
+ *
+ * `WS_OS_FULFILLED_CAPS` / `WS_HUMAN_RELAYED_CAPS` mirror the Rust
+ * `OS_FULFILLED_CAPS` / `HUMAN_RELAYED_CAPS` registries. The server is the
+ * ACP client-of-record: OS caps are fulfilled locally; only human caps are
+ * relayed to the browser. A browser WS request for an OS cap is rejected
+ * with `err.code: "unsupported"`.
+ *
+ * Runtime-neutral: no `@tauri-apps/*` imports, no `@renderer/*` imports.
+ * ESM-first. Strict-typed (no `any`).
+ */
+
+// ============================================================================
+// Event `type` names (17) — acp:* prefix-dropped, snake_case (AC2)
+// ============================================================================
+
+/**
+ * The 16 `acp:*` event names from `src-tauri/src/acp/events.rs` with the
+ * `acp:` prefix dropped, plus the relay-level `auth_required` (not from
+ * `events.rs`). 17 total.
+ */
+export const WS_EVENT_TYPES = [
+  // Session/agent lifecycle (reliable)
+  'agent_spawned',
+  'session_created',
+  'session_closed',
+  'agent_disconnected',
+  'agent_error',
+  // Session state (reliable)
+  'tool_call',
+  'mode_update',
+  'config_options_update',
+  'session_info_update',
+  'usage_update',
+  // Permission (reliable)
+  'permission_request',
+  // Prompt turn lifecycle (idempotent)
+  'prompt_complete',
+  // High-frequency streams (lossy)
+  'message_chunk',
+  'tool_call_update',
+  'commands_update',
+  'plan_update',
+  // Relay-level (not from events.rs) (reliable)
+  'auth_required'
+] as const
+
+/** Union of all WS event `type` strings. */
+export type WsEventType = (typeof WS_EVENT_TYPES)[number]
+
+// ============================================================================
+// Request `type` names (13) — acp_* command names prefix-dropped (AC2)
+// ============================================================================
+
+/**
+ * The 17 WS request `type` names. Mirror the existing `acp_*` Tauri command
+ * names with the `acp_` prefix dropped, snake_case. `create_session` maps to
+ * the Tauri command `acp_new_session` (NOT `acp_create_session`); the WS
+ * request `type` is `create_session` per architecture naming.
+ *
+ * Agent lifecycle (`spawn_agent` / `kill_agent` / `list_agents`) mirrors
+ * `acp_spawn_agent` / `acp_kill_agent` / `acp_list_agents` for web desktop parity.
+ *
+ * `subscribe` (Story 1.6) is relay-level (not an `acp_*` command): binds a
+ * connection to a session event log with an optional `lastSeq` cursor.
+ */

+  'cancel_prompt',

+  'set_mode',
